desc: Implement the core y-basis BFS-layer DP with reduced state and sparse transitions, including precomputation of factorials, inverse factorials, binomial coefficients, and transition coefficients for (y^t-1)^s.
Add the final binomial transform from y-basis to x-basis and produce outputs for all required edge counts M.
Test against the provided samples and small brute-force verifier, including N=2, negative inclusion-exclusion coefficients modulo P, and performance checks for N=30.
If the core DP is too slow or memory-heavy, try the exponential-generating-function variant or a further reduced-state optimization; keep direct x-basis convolution only as a fallback.
